description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the checkout process in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It includes methods for managing subscription records, such as adding, editing, retrieving, and deleting subscriptions, products within subscriptions, options, and history/log entries.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class managing subscription records, products, options, status updates, history, and logs within the checkout process of an OpenCart system.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new subscription record in the database with provided data, including related products.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record with new data, also replacing associated products.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the subscription's status by its ID.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining cycles of a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial cycles of a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Sets the next scheduled date for the subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes subscriptions associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches the details of a specific subscription by its ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions based on provided filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions matching filters.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to a subscription, including options.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all products linked to a specific subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches a subscription product record by order ID and order product ID.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a subscription product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription option.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options for a subscription product.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a status change history record for a subscription.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Logs a subscription-related event.
